sourceTitle: An Essay on the Shaking Palsy
description: "An Essay on the Shaking Palsy" by James Parkinson is a scientific publication written in the early 19th century. This pioneering work is primarily focused on the medical understanding of a condition now known as Parkinson's disease, characterized by involuntary tremors and a decline in muscular control.
